verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party public API reference at docs.sentry.io/api/, including endpoint pages such as 'Bulk Mutate a List of Issues'. It also publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec in the getsentry/sentry-api-schema repo. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in place, and probes of the OpenAPI paths on the docs site all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, any independent or hands-on confirmation of an interactive explorer.
